talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 50 solo PCPs winding down in Tennessee; 5 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Brentwood 37027, Nashville 37203, Smyrna 37167) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~8,229 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.

**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Lincoln County, Hardeman County, Lauderdale County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 18 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~165,600 patients across 138 at-risk practices statewide.
